name: 31601 · Valdosta, GA
findings: ZIP 31601 (Valdosta) has 117 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31601 (Valdosta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 31601 (Valdosta) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
